marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 15 knots diminishing to light near noon then
increasing to northeast 20 this afternoon except light in Prince Albert Sound.
Wind diminishing to northeast 15 Wednesday morning. Scattered flurries. Temperatures plus 2 falling to minus 6 Wednesday
evening. <br/>

marine.text:
Seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 early this afternoon except
less than 1 in Prince Albert Sound today and tonight.<br/>
